introduction: South Carolina unemployment claims use DEW’s MyBenefits portal. Weekly certifications and SCWOS job searches are separate ongoing tasks.
description: South Carolina unemployment claims use DEW’s MyBenefits portal. Weekly certifications and SCWOS job searches are separate ongoing tasks.

sections.who: DEW assesses covered earnings, job separation and continued eligibility. Report actual wages and availability for each claimed week.
sections.get: Approved payments provide temporary support for eligible weeks after the required waiting period.
sections.docs:
• Social Security and identity information.
  • Employer contacts and work history.
  • Military or federal employment records where applicable.
  • Weekly earnings and search records.
sections.apply:
1. File through MyBenefits

    Use DEW’s filing instructions.

  2. Complete verification

    Follow identity and eligibility requests and save the confirmation.

  3. Certify and search

    File weekly claims and complete the state’s required SCWOS searches.
sections.after: Monitor notices and report work accurately. The agency lists 866-831-1724 for filing help.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using DEW current filing and weekly requirements. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The state says an unpaid waiting period equivalent to one full benefit week must be served.
Are job searches done in the claims portal?
DEW directs the required weekly searches to SCWOS.
Where do I file after moving out of state?
The agency says wages and the relevant employer location determine where to claim, rather than residence alone.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
